name: Kotal Kahn believed D'Vorah was working for Raiden
notes: After the Earthrealm prisoners escape and Shinnok's amulet disappears, Kotal Kahn accepts his retainers' mistaken inference that D'Vorah is working with Raiden. The Fact records Kotal's belief only; the repository separately records the objective Story Mode reveal that D'Vorah secretly serves Quan Chi.
